domains.name: Print Production Handoffs
domains.scope: Reconcile print production intent with quantity, proof, separation, boundary, personalization and assembly evidence without prescribing machinery operation.

skills.name: print-page-section-quantity-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile logical pages, printer-supplied sections and finished-copy quantities when a print order mixes covers, blanks or different editions.

skills.name: print-proof-change-disposition
skills.description: Reconcile proof corrections against an exact production revision when comments, approvals and replacement files disagree.

skills.name: spot-color-separation-evidence-review
skills.description: Compare intended ink roles with supplied separation evidence when a print file may contain duplicate spot definitions, unexpected process conversion or missing marks.

skills.name: trim-bleed-content-boundary-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile trim, bleed and protected-content boundaries against a supplier's job specification when artwork dimensions or edge placement are uncertain.

skills.name: variable-print-record-template-correspondence
skills.description: Reconcile supplied data records with personalized print templates and rendered samples when field mapping, conditional content or record coverage may be wrong.

skills.name: print-finishing-assembly-handoff
skills.description: Translate approved multi-part print intent into an evidence-based finishing and assembly handoff when part order, orientation or edition matching could be confused.
